note: The headings list contains only 7.2, 7.2.1 and 7.2.2, so the chapter's earlier section on animal tissues is unrepresented: P01 is clearly that text (organs made of epithelial, connective, muscular and neural tissue) but has no heading, hence from_heading 'unsure' for subtopic 1. All of the frog's organ systems sit under the single heading 7.2.2 Anatomy, so subtopics 5-11 share that from_heading; they were kept separate because NEET questions target one frog organ system at a time. Subtopic 12 (P19, usefulness of frogs) also has no sub-heading of its own and was attributed to 7.2. The SUMMARY is split: P20 (cells, tissues, organs, division of labour) went to subtopic 1 and P21 (Rana tigrina) to subtopic 2. EXERCISES (P22) asks for a digestive-system diagram and the function of the ureters; it was attached to the digestive-system subtopic.
